summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the date, time, and location of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, scheduled for September 10, 2026, with a record date of July 17, 2026. The filing is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or management change. No deal terms, premiums, or structural changes are involved. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. proxy mailing notice; this is an ordinary procedural filing with no risk-arb angle.
